previewRules:
How to play
Each round, secretly load 1 to 6 crates.
Fits under the limit? Everyone banks their crates.
Too heavy? The cable snaps: the heaviest loader loses 3, the lightest gets +2.
Signals
Before loading, everyone shows Going light, Going heavy or Shrug. It’s a promise you don’t have to keep.
Timing
5 seconds to signal, 10 to load. No pick in time? The porter loads 3.
Ties
Every tied heaviest loader loses 3 and every tied lightest loader gets +2.
Winning
8 rounds. The last two count double. Most points wins; fewer blames breaks a tie.

Keyboard: L H S to signal, 1–6 to pick, Enter to lock in.

THE GUEST HANDBOOK

A little greed.
A very old cable.
Bluff. Signal anything. Secretly load 1–6 crates.
Fit? Bank crates. Snap? No bank; heaviest −3, lightest +2.
8 lifts. Last two ×2. Most points wins; fewer blames breaks ties.

You have 5 seconds to signal and 10 to load. A missed pick loads 3. Signals are promises you don’t have to keep.

Every tied heaviest loader takes blame; every tied lightest loader salvages. If everyone ties on a snap, both apply. Final two rounds double all points, penalties, and salvage.

Light means 1–3 crates; heavy means 4–6 for the Honest Abe award. Shrug makes no promise. Equal scores and equal blame counts share the win.

Keyboard: L / H / S to signal · 1–6 to pick · Enter to lock.
